configurationLevel.description:
The level from which the configuration is applied.
 * `LOCATION` - The applied services of location level.
 * `ORGANIZATION` - The applied services of the organization level.

name.description: Name given to a translation pattern.

matchingPattern.description: Matching pattern given to a translation pattern.

replacementPattern.description: Replacement pattern given to a translation pattern.

translatedNumber.description: The modified number after matching against `matchingPattern` and replacing with corresponding `replacementPattern`.
